snippet.title: Exactly 9 Minutes ⏳ Riddle #6 Answer + Riddle #7: Wolf, Goat & Cabbage Across the River #shorts
snippet.description:
Yesterday's answer: start both sand timers when the egg goes in. At 4 minutes the small timer runs out: flip it. At 7 minutes the big timer runs out: flip it too. At 8 minutes the small timer runs out again: flip the big one. It has exactly one minute of sand left, so when it runs out, that's exactly 9 minutes.

Riddle #7: Person 1 must take a wolf, a goat and a cabbage across a river. The boat is tiny: it holds Person 1 and only one more thing. Left alone, the wolf will eat the goat, and the goat will eat the cabbage. How does Person 1 get all three across safely?

Comment your answer. The answer drops tomorrow, at sunrise. 🌅
